title: oreogrammitis archboldii
intro: Oreogrammitis archboldii, commonly known as the Papuan Stag's Horn Fern, is a species of epiphytic fern that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
